lines.text: Hey guys, it is time to compare the Apple iPhone Duo with the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8
and see which one of these is a better device.
So the Samsung Z Fold 8 starts at $1899 in the US and $1,79,000 in India.
The iPhone Duo however costs $2,000 in the US and Rs 3,00,000 in India.
So there's a huge price difference in India and this is something you all should note.
Starting with the design, I honestly think Samsung did an amazing job here.
The Fold 8 has a much cleaner and more symmetrical design with those sharp boxy edges and corners.
Here even the software makes full use of the display, the application interface, home screen,
and application drawer all use an edge-to-edge interface.
So basically Samsung is using more of the display area to show content.
The iPhone Duo however takes a different approach with its asymmetrical D-shaped cover display.
Yeah, I love it too because it's unique.
I also love the opening and closing animations and how seamlessly transition feels.
But practically I think Z Fold 8 looks more balanced.
The iPhone Duo's software interface is made to adapt to that D-shaped cover display
which means the right side has some limitations.
We have a huge selfie camera on the top right corner, the status bias on the right,
and we will also have navigation controls on the right.
So definitely a unique UI but I think Samsung has made a better use of the screen.
Samsung is using more of the display area for actual content which is more practical.
Now iOS for the iPhone Duo versus Samsung One UI 9 on the Galaxy Z Fold 8.
See, both are the best of the best.
I love the iPhone Duo software and animation.
Samsung has done an amazing job too but it's nothing completely new.
It's basically same non-foldable phone UI just in a different form factor.
It looks decent and works well but I would appreciate a new UI for a wide folding device.
The iPhone Duo is using titanium which sounds more durable
but the Samsung Z Fold 8 is lighter and thinner than the iPhone Duo so this is something you
all should note.
In my usage with the Galaxy Z Fold 8, I haven't had any issue with the hinge or the folding
or unfolding mechanism.
But the area where the iPhone Duo absolutely beats Samsung is water and dust protection.
The iPhone Duo has IP68 while the Samsung Fold 8 has IP48.
IP68 gives you much better protection against both dust and water.
6 means it's fully dust tight while the second number 8 means it can handle being submerged
in water under specific testing condition.
The Fold 8 has an IP48 rating which means it has same level of protection against solid
objects as the first number is 4 but still has an aid for water protection.
So the iPhone Duo has a clear advantage in dust protection which is something must for a
folding device.
The iPhone Duo also has Apple Pencil support while Samsung doesn't.
Samsung dropped S Pen support on the Fold a few years back to cut the cost so Apple got
a clear advantage there.
Now Apple has pulled off something quite impressive on the inner display by implementing an under
display camera.
Yeah of course this will affect image quality compared to a normal camera but it makes a
lot of sense on the foldable.
But it's the smartest move cause you guys can use the selfie camera on the cover screen or
you can use the main camera as a selfie camera while using the cover screen as a viewfinder
for better images.
Plus you also get a full screen inner display with no interruption for watching movies or
playing games.
So again having a full screen inner display is a very welcome change and with the nano texturizing
on top, reflections and the crease are much less noticeable.
You do get better control over reflections but the display can have some compromises in
brightness, colors and overall clarity.
Cameras on both these devices should be decent.
Both have a main and an ultra wide angle camera on the rear with no periscope or telephoto camera.
So the setup is quite similar.
And again both these phones can capture selfies using the rear camera while using the cover screen
as a viewfinder.
And finally performance is where I think for the first time we may not see a huge difference.
I did a speed test comparison between the A20 Pro and Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5
for Galaxy and Samsung came out much better in video rendering and some other areas.
Even AAA games and emulator work better on Samsung in my testing.
So this where Samsung is better.
Battery life should also be similar but we'll see that in the battery test coming soon.
So I think the Galaxy Z Fold 8 looks like a better device overall for markets like India
where the price gap is huge.
But if you want the best of the best like IP68 protection, Apple Pencil support, a full
screen inner display with an under display camera, a better experience for gaming and
watching movies then the iPhone Duo is the one you should get.
This is all guys thanks so much for watching.
Your thoughts in the comment section below and I'll meet you guys in the next one.
Like, share, subscribe and peace out.
